name: ares_lookup_ico
description: AUTHORITATIVE for Czech company identity — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "who is IČO 00177041", "is this Czech company still active", "what is Škoda Auto's VAT number". Looks up one economic subject in the Czech Ministry of Finance ARES register by its IČO (8-digit company id) and returns the registered trading name, legal form, registered seat address, founding date, dissolution date if any, the DIČ (VAT) number, and the CZ-NACE activity codes.

ico.description: Czech IČO (identifikační číslo osoby), 8 digits. Leading zeros optional — "177041" and "00177041" both work, e.g. "00177041" (Škoda Auto a.s.).

name: ares_search_name
description: AUTHORITATIVE for finding a Czech company when you only know its name — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Czech companies called Škoda", "find the IČO for Alza". Searches the Czech Ministry of Finance ARES register of economic subjects by trading name and returns the matching subjects with IČO, legal form, seat address and founding date, plus the total number of matches so you can tell a precise hit from a common word.

name.description: Trading name or fragment to search for, e.g. "Škoda Auto" or "Alza". Diacritics are optional — ARES matches accent-insensitively.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result set, for paging past the first `limit` matches. Default 0.

onlyActive.description: When true, drop subjects that already have a dissolution date (datumZaniku). Default false — dissolved companies are returned and flagged with active:false.

name: ares_vat_reliability
description: AUTHORITATIVE for "is this Czech company a reliable VAT payer" — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for the standard pre-invoice check in Czech B2B ("is CZ27082440 an unreliable VAT payer (nespolehlivý plátce DPH)", "which bank accounts has this supplier published for VAT"). Checks the Czech Financial Administration's unreliable VAT payer register for one DIČ (VAT number, with or without the CZ prefix) or IČO (8-digit company id). Returns an explicit status: "unreliable" (flagged, with the date the flag was published), "reliable" (a registered VAT payer NOT flagged), or "not_a_vat_payer" (the id is not in the VAT payer register at all). "not_a_vat_payer" is NOT a clean bill of health, it means there is no VAT registration to be reliable about. A malformed id is refused with an error rather than reported as not found. For companies it also returns the published bank accounts (an invoice paid to an unpublished account can leave the buyer liable for the VAT), the tax office code, and the register's answer date. Individuals (sole traders identified by a personal-number DIČ) get the status only: name, address and accounts are withheld.

id.description: Czech DIČ (VAT number) or IČO (company id). "CZ27082440", "27082440" and spaced forms all work, e.g. "27082440" (Alza.cz a.s.). An 8-digit value is also looked up in ARES so a sole trader's IČO resolves to its real DIČ.
